**Triage Summary:**

All six findings are marked CRITICAL but carry extremely low exploit probability (EPSS ≤0.029) and lack both available fixes and KEV catalog inclusion, indicating these are likely theoretical or low-impact vulnerabilities. The findings cluster around three packages: perl-base (3 CVEs), libc components (2 CVEs sharing the same CVE ID), and zlib1g (1 CVE). The absence of patches and real-world exploitation evidence suggests these may be future-dated CVEs, misclassified severity ratings, or vulnerabilities with minimal practical attack surface in this context.

**Recommended Action:** Approve the build with a note to re-evaluate these findings once patches become available or threat intelligence clarifies exploitability. If this is a production-critical system, document the risk acceptance; otherwise, proceed—the CRITICAL labels are not supported by actionable exploit data.
